meta.group: Deep Dive into the Observer API
subtitle: The MutationObserver API is an observer specialized for detecting changes in the DOM. It can detect not only size changes like width or height, but also changes in attributes like class. Let's look at how to use this observer, and how to use it conveniently in React through a custom hook.
